​I recently visited Chiang Mai Hall, located next to Central Chiang Mai Airport Plaza, for a book fair with my son. I was very impressed with the event's organization and the quality of books available.
​They had an excellent selection of books, with a good mix of both English and Thai language titles. We found some fantastic books at really great prices, which was a huge plus. The layout was easy to navigate, and the whole experience was smooth and enjoyable.
​This venue seems perfect for events like this, and I was very happy with our visit. We'll definitely be back for future book fairs or other similar events held here. Highly recommended

Chiang Mai Hall, located in Central Chiang Mai Airport, is a versatile and modern venue ideal for concerts, exhibitions, and events. It offers flexible seating and convenient amenities like parking and dining. Visitors appreciate its easy access and spacious layout. Some note that acoustics can vary, and the size may not suit smaller events, but overall, it’s a popular, well-equipped space for various gatherings in Chiang Mai.
